title: The director's ledger is the transcript of record, not the hang-up POST
deviations_from_card: Critic revision applied: the ledger is read once right after the session loads, before the completed-session duplicate check, and the merged+clamped+capped array feeds both discardedTurnCount checks, the persist and runInterviewScorecard (clamp/cap moved above the terminal guard; its warnings still log after the refusals). One addition beyond the card: an EMPTY body also passes through unchanged, so a stray empty finalize cannot be turned into a completed, scored call from the ledger alone (the route's existing empty-body guards keep governing it). Ledger read failure degrades to body passthrough with a console.error. Ledger read uses limit 20000 (listInterviewEvents' max) instead of importing MAX_INTERVIEW_EVENTS_PER_SESSION from director-step.ts, to keep the route graph unchanged. Doc committed alone under the lock (2bc9fb574) before the test/feat pair.
notes: All 8 card acceptance cases red before (module absent), green after; test count 16 = 9 pure + 7 route (the undirected-passthrough route case was already green, as intended). Every complete-*.test.ts, discarded-turns, rate-limit-contract, route-tenancy, spend-doors, interview-run and error-hygiene suites green. tsc exit 2 is foreign only: untracked kpi-sim/ tree plus sibling in-flight tests (pipeline/[id]/entry-actions, entry-route, shell/setup, jds/[slug]); zero errors in my files. Full test:unit exit 1 on foreign files only: pipeline/[id] capability/authz tests, entry-route, route-capability-coverage (pipeline routes), python-runner-concurrency, jdPublicVariant flake. test:perf exit 1 on app/page.tsx only (1422/8995 vs 1421/8992) - my new module is imported solely by app/api/interview/complete/route.ts, which is not on the page graph, and the route graph did not fail; not my share. For billing-subscriptions/A: route.ts change is self-contained (ledger read + merge block after the session load; downstream calls unchanged in signature).
